name: unrest
description: Faction-conflict ledger — grip/heat/pressure per derived city block, decayed on read and driven by an idle-gated forcing tick. Phase 1a: state only, no player-facing surface.

config.BLOCK: 12 — the cell is a 12x12 square of grid coordinates (blocks.js)
config.flagKey: unrest_ledger — the one world_flags key this plugin writes, and it is the only writer

dataSchema.note: No table. The ledger is one versioned world_flags blob, RAM-authoritative with write-behind — ~10 cells x 4 numbers does not justify a schema change, a registry entry and a read-tier decision.
